irogotu.m: Well hello there. Another adventurer coming to steal my bounty. This is MY CAVE. The treasure will be MINE!

irogotu1.m: That whelp Gandir? He was in my way. I merely used him as a tool to dig deeper into the cave.

irogotu2.m: Besides, I never really liked him anyway.
r: I guess he deserved to die. Did he have a ring on him?
Jan mentioned something about a ring?

irogotu3.m: NO! You cannot have it. It's mine! And who are you anyway kid, coming down here to disturb me?!
r: I'm not a kid anymore! Now give me that ring!
Give me that ring and we might both come out of here alive.

irogotu4.m: No. If you want it you will have to take it from me by force, and I should tell you that my powers are great. Besides, you probably wouldn't dare fight me anyway.
r: Very well, let's see who dies here.
By the Shadow, Gandir will be avenged.

jan.10:
Jan tells me his story, where he and his two friends Gandir and Irogotu, went down the hole to dig for a hidden treasure, but they started fighting and Irogotu killed Gandir in his rage.
I should bring back Gandir's ring from Irogotu, and see Jan when I have it.
jan.100: Irogotu is dead. I have brought Jan the ring of Gandir, and avenged his friend.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
